guarantees.claim: app_mux_sel_e defines four symbolic values with specific 5-bit encodings: SelNone=5'b10100, SelApp=5'b11001, SelOutLen=5'b00010, SelSw=5'b01111.

uncertain_points.claim: app_mux_sel_e enum covers only 4 of 32 possible 5-bit values; the other 28 values are not defined and have no documented safe behavior. If a select signal of this type ever takes an out-of-range value (e.g., due to reset to 0, bit-flip, or uninitialized register), the downstream mux may select an unintended or undefined path, potentially leaking secrets or bypassing output length constraints.
uncertain_points.cond: any assignment or transition to a non-enumerated value on app_mux_sel_e
uncertain_points.risk: Unspecified mux routing could expose internal state, clear keys inadvertently, or allow SW to control paths intended for internal use only.
